bodyHtml:
🍏 Apple Specialists · Independent · Logan Since 2008

Apple Repairs Logan. Your Local Apple Experts, Not The Apple Store.

We are an independent Apple specialist in Logan. That means no shipping your Mac interstate, no waiting weeks for a booking, and no being pushed toward a new machine when the one you have can be fixed or set up properly. Whether your Mac needs a hands-on repair or you just need help getting Apple gear working the way it should, we can help.

Get Apple Help Mac Hardware Repairs
✓ Local & Independent
✓ Since 2008
✓ Out-Of-Warranty Welcome
✓ Open 7 Days
The Apple We Look After

Macs, And The Apple Gear Around Them.

Most of what we do is Macs: MacBook, MacBook Pro, MacBook Air, iMac, Mac Mini, Mac Studio and Mac Pro, back to the older models Apple no longer touches. If yours has a broken screen, a dead battery or a board fault, that is a hands-on job for our Mac repairs service. We also help with the rest of the Apple ecosystem that sits around your Mac, including your iPhone and iPad when it comes to setup, backups and getting everything talking to each other.

Why Independent

A Real Person, Down The Road.

The Apple Store has its place, but for a lot of Logan locals it means a drive, a queue and sometimes posting the machine away. We are local, we answer the phone, and older or out-of-warranty Macs are welcome here rather than turned away. Your data stays with us in Logan, and you deal with the same people from quote to finished job.

Apple Support

Setup, Software And Everyday Apple Help.

🆕

New Mac Setup

A new Mac set up the right way from the start, with your apps, printer and accounts ready to go.

📦

Data Migration

Moving from an old Mac, or switching from Windows to Mac, with your files and settings brought across.

🕐

Time Machine Backups

A proper backup set up so that if the worst happens, your photos and documents are safe.

☁️

iCloud & Apple ID

Locked out of an Apple ID, or iCloud storage full and syncing gone wrong? We sort it out with you.

🔄

macOS Updates

Updates that fail, stall or leave the Mac misbehaving, checked over and put right.

🐌

Slow Mac

A Mac that has become slow or unreliable diagnosed and tuned so it feels usable again.

🛡️

Virus & Malware

Macs are not immune. Odd pop-ups or browser hijacks removed and the Mac cleaned up.

📧

Mail & Microsoft 365

Email, Microsoft 365 and calendars set up and syncing across your Mac, iPhone and iPad.

Why Choose Us

Why Logan Apple Owners Come To Us.

  • Apple has been our focus since 2008. A big share of the work through our door is Apple, so these machines are familiar territory.
  • Independent, so we work for you. We give honest advice on whether to repair, upgrade or replace, without a sales target behind it.
  • Older and out-of-warranty Macs welcome. A model Apple will no longer service is often still very fixable, and worth keeping.
  • Your data stays local. Nothing is shipped interstate. Your Mac and your files stay here in Logan with us.
  • One point of contact. The same people handle your job from the first quote through to picking it up.
  • Open 7 days. Fit a drop-off or a call around your week, not just business hours.
Get Apple Help
Broken Screen Or Battery?

That Is A Hardware Job.

If your Mac has a physical fault, a cracked screen, a swollen battery, water damage or a board that will not power on, head to our dedicated Mac repairs page for the full list of hardware work we do, including board-level logic board repair. Lost files in the process? We also handle data recovery.

Need A Hand With Anything Apple?

Tell us what is going on. We will point you the right way and give you a price the same day.

Get Apple Help
